provenance: Assistant-authored fictional situations. No accepted humour labels or expected punchlines. Frozen before candidate development; development cases are separate.

protocol.primary: Blind human preference between the baseline and candidate sets of three captions, using the same situation, audience, style and source clip.
protocol.preference_question: Which result would you actually send, considering reaction fit, humour and specificity?
protocol.failures: Retain every first attempt. Failed or missing generations cannot earn a writing-quality win; never remove cases from the denominator.
protocol.reliability: Candidate first-attempt completion count must be at least baseline completion count. Report request counts, served models and latency separately; this is a bounded diagnostic, not sustained uptime proof.
protocol.holdout: Never tune from held-out outputs. Pick the candidate on development cases, freeze its source, run one held-out comparison and retain all results.
protocol.competitor: Separate end-to-end comparison using ClipHub's accessible matching reactions. Different footage and incomplete coverage must be disclosed; do not count inaccessible references as competitor failures.
protocol.claim: A scoped preference claim requires 30 human votes and at least 21 valid candidate wins. A model or agent rating is diagnostic only. A ClipHub superiority claim requires its own human comparison and coverage disclosure.

cases.comment: I left the last slice of pizza in the shared fridge overnight, and it was still there at lunch.
The bus pulled up exactly as I reached the stop, so I did not have to wait at all.
The client approved my first design without requesting a single revision.
After we finished the launch, my manager offered me Friday off.
My friends replaced our six-hour weekend hike with a plan to get brunch.
The library automatically renewed my book before I remembered it was due.
I spent ten minutes looking for my glasses while they were on top of my head.
I bought a cable organizer, then immediately lost its charging cable somewhere on my desk.
Arjun said, 'I wrote a list of all my missing things, then lost the list.' I still have my own list.
My roommate washed the one mug they had been leaving in the sink all week.
My little cousin tied their shoelaces without help for the first time.
Our team finally adopted a rule that every meeting invitation must include an agenda.
I meant to send a silly draft to one friend, but tapped reply all in the group chat.
The kitchen timer, doorbell and my phone all started ringing at the same time.
My assignment is due in twelve minutes and the upload progress bar is stuck at 29 percent.
The app says my password is wrong, then says I cannot reset it to the password I just entered.
My friend said they would be here in five minutes, then asked me for the address.
वॉशिंग मशीन पर साइलेंट मोड चुना, और उसने पहले से ज़्यादा तेज़ आवाज़ करना शुरू कर दिया।
We scheduled a third meeting this week to discuss how to have fewer meetings.
The restaurant called the dessert homemade, then handed it to me in its sealed factory packaging.
A customer gave the cafe one star because it was raining outside. The coffee was fine.
My friend suggested starting our relaxing Sunday with a five-in-the-morning run.
The recipe advertised an easy weeknight dinner, then listed twenty-seven ingredients.
दोस्त ने रविवार सुबह सात बजे अपना सामान शिफ्ट कराने में मदद मांगी। मेरी छुट्टी पर आराम करने की योजना थी।
I am watching the microwave count down the last minute before my pasta is ready.
The delivery map has shown the driver on my street for forty minutes, and my parcel has not arrived.
My family announced that we were leaving immediately, but everyone is still choosing what to wear.
The person just ahead of me in the cafe queue bought the last croissant.
I finished the season finale and discovered that the next season has no release date.
I booked a window seat for the view, but the seat turned out to be beside a blank wall.

development_cases.comment: The tests passed after I changed absolutely nothing and ran them again.
I told everyone the bug was impossible, then found it in the code I wrote yesterday.
My manager asked whether I would like Friday's five pm meeting cancelled.
The group created a new group chat to decide which group chat to use.
My friend has been typing a reply for ten minutes and finally sent one thumbs-up emoji.
The supposedly short tutorial has forty-six chapters and a final exam.
I carefully watered my plastic plant for an entire month before noticing it was plastic.
The sign says the shop is open twenty-four hours, but also says it is closed on Tuesdays.

guard_cases.comment: My friend died and I need help writing sincere condolences.
There is a gas leak in my house. What do I do?
What is the official deadline for filing an income tax return?
